{{rt|101|Hoenn}} }} '''It All Ends Now VIII''' (Japanese: '''最終超決戦VIII''' ''The Final Battle VIII''), titled '''The Final Showdown VIII''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 267th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 87th and final chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''The Promised Day''' (Japanese: '''約束の日''' ''The Promised Day'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Goal on the 80th Day''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} With [[Feefee]]'s [[Evolution]], {{adv|Ruby}} asks her if she's ready to fight. Ruby looks to {{adv|Sapphire}} and states that now that the ancient Pokémon are gone, it's their time to fight together. Ruby climbs on top of Feefee while Sapphire climbs on top of {{p|Tropius|Troppy}}. [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]] send out their {{p|Camerupt}} and {{p|Walrein}} to fight back, but Sapphire has [[Chic]] send them flying with a powerful {{m|Sky Uppercut}}. Ruby follows up by having [[Mumu]] use {{m|Muddy Water}}, which Sapphire notes as the combination attack they learned on {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}. Maxie and Archie are unfazed, and send out more Pokémon to counterattack. As the battle commences, [[Wallace]] notes that Archie and Maxie must intend to battle to the end if they sent out their remaining team. Wallace's guess is proven wrong when he notices the two stealing his aircar and driving away. Maxie and Archie decide to let their opponents live, as with the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s, they can easily get rid of them later. The [[Trick Master]] tries to stop the two from escaping, but is easily swatted away. Seeing what happened, Sapphire decides to use the [[New Mauville]] generator in addition to {{TP|Ruby|Plusle}} and {{TP|Sapphire|Minun}}'s electric energy to stop Archie and Maxie. By summoning the electrical energy stored inside the generator, Plusle and Minun shoot a powerful attack at the aircar. Maxie and Archie try to escape, but the attack reaches them and surrounds the car in a dangerous field of electricity. Ruby gives Sapphire his [[Pokégear]] and has her put up the aircar's shield to protect Maxie and Archie. Stating that enough people have died, Ruby decides to simply retrieve the Red and Blue Orbs now that Maxie and Archie cannot move. Sapphire questions Ruby's motives, as no Pokémon they have could possibly move through the electrical field and survive. Ruby states that he has one Pokémon that can and prepares to release it from its {{i|Poké Ball}}. Sapphire recalls the pose Ruby is in from [[PS183|back when he saved her]] from a {{p|Seviper}}. Ruby reveals that he doesn't know what the Pokémon he has is, as the [[Pokédex]] won't identify it, but he has had it ever since he came to [[Hoenn]]. Ruby opens the Poké Ball, and releases his sixth and final Pokémon, a {{adv|Celebi}}. Back on {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}, [[Juan]] is shocked to see that Ruby has a Celebi. Juan quickly realizes that Ruby having Celebi makes sense, as it explains why time became unstable when Ruby and Sapphire entered and left Mirage Island. Celebi passes through the electrical field and takes the Red and Blue Orb from Maxie and Archie's hands. Back in [[Sootopolis City]], [[Gabby and Ty|Gabby]] notes that the energy field surrounding the city is disappearing, which means that it will fall back into place soon. Somewhere, an exhausted Ruby lies with Sapphire right next to him. As Celebi flies past them, Ruby sees images of [[Courtney]], {{Steven}}, and {{adv|Norman}}——those who lost their lives in the final battle. Celebi smashes the Red and Blue Orbs to pieces, which break into two gemstones. Ruby and Sapphire begin floating into the air, while Celebi stays behind. Ruby and Sapphire suddenly wake up in the [[Pokémon Association]]'s headquarters, where they are thanked by their friends and allies. Ruby is shocked to see that Steven and Norman are alive, and sees Courtney flying past the airship as well. Courtney states that she feels like she had come back from the dead, and decides to take this second chance to pursue a life of {{pkmn|Contest}}s again. Ruby realizes that he had [[Time travel|passed through a time slip]] and ended up in a slightly different future. Looking at Celebi's empty Poké Ball, Ruby guesses that Celebi joined his team because it knew that all of this would happen. The [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] greets Ruby and notes that it's been a while since they last met. This causes Ruby and Sapphire to learn that the current day is September 19, which means that their bet only has one day left before it ends. The counter of the bet continues at one day. Ruby and Sapphire desperately ask Wallace and Norman if they can arrange a Contest and Gym battle for them. Wallace and Norman accept their requests, much to Ruby and Sapphire's joy. The next day, Sapphire rushes back to her [[Secret Base]] on {{rt|101|Hoenn}}. She notes that Norman was a tough opponent, but if he wasn't injured, he would be an even tougher one. Despite this, Sapphire managed to beat Norman, and finally has all eight Hoenn Gym Badges. As she climbs into her Secret Base, Sapphire wonders if Ruby managed to beat the Contests, as it's only been a day since their exhausting battle. Upon entering her base, Sapphire is shocked to see it filled with [[Decoration|various toys and furniture]]. Ruby appears from inside a tent and reveals that he did it to brighten up Sapphire's base. When Sapphire demands to know what happened to Ruby's Contest challenge, Ruby reveals that he had won, as he presents his entire [[party|team]] and all 20 [[Ribbon]]s. Ruby reveals that due to the [[Contest Hall]]s in {{to|Verdanturf}}, {{ci|Slateport}}, and {{to|Fallarbor}} being badly damaged, [[Battle Tent]]s had to be created to replace them. Ruby decides that since the both of them completed their goals on time, the bet ends in a draw. After seeing that Sapphire's team is covered in dirt, Ruby decides to groom them. Sapphire, confused at Ruby's behavior, wonders if he remembers what they said back in Sootopolis. Believing that Ruby may have forgotten, Sapphire tries to remind Ruby of what they said but has trouble getting her words out. Suddenly, the television turns on, which is revealed to be Gabby interviewing [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]]. On the television, Ruby's mother asks Ruby to come home so that they can celebrate his birthday as well as Sapphire's. Around the Hoenn region, the people get back to their daily lives. [[Wanda]] brings food to {{adv|Riley}} as he continues construction with the help of the wild {{p|Loudred}}. [[Mr. Briney]] and [[Peeko]] prepare to board the [[S.S. Tidal]]. [[Captain Stern]], [[Dock]], and the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman take deep breaths. In [[Fallarbor Town]], [[Professor Cozmo]] and [[Professor Cozmo's assistants|his assistants]] are joined by Wallace's cheerleaders. {{adv|Wally}} writes a letter to [[Professor Birch]] and Ruby, where he returns the Pokédex and [[Rara]], respectively. [[Roxanne]] and [[Brawly]] talk to each other. [[Wattson]] flies on the New Mauville generator with the [[Trick Master]] riding on a robot next to him. [[Flannery]] welcomes people to re-opened {{to|Lavaridge}} hot springs and sees [[Tabitha]] in the crowd. Elsewhere, Courtney grows {{Berries}} in the blazing heat. As Ruby and Sapphire run back home, Ruby asks how well he groomed Sapphire's Pokémon. Sapphire, imitating Ruby, states that he did a beautiful job. As they run, the two exchange a wink at each other. Somewhere else, a {{i|Ruby}} and a {{i|Sapphire}} produced by the destruction of the Red and Blue Orbs wash ashore. A figure picks them up, who is revealed to be {{adv|Giovanni}}. He beckons to his new underlings—[[Sird]], [[Carr]], and [[Orm]]—stating that there is work to be done, and they leave the scene. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} defeat [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]]. * Ruby is revealed to have captured {{adv|Celebi}} prior to moving to [[Hoenn]], and [[Released Pokémon|releases]] it. * Celebi uses its powers to revive {{adv|Norman}}, {{Steven}}, and [[Courtney]]. * Ruby wins all [[Ribbon]]s, while {{adv|Sapphire}} gets her last [[Badge|Gym Badge]] from Norman. * Peace returns to the Hoenn [[region]]. * The [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s turn into gems, which are found by {{adv|Giovanni}}. * {{adv|Wally}} returns Ruby's {{p|Kirlia}}, [[Rara]], and the third [[Pokédex]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * {{adv|Norman}} * {{adv|Wally}} * [[Roxanne]] * [[Brawly]] * [[Wattson]] * [[Flannery]] * [[Winona]] * [[Tate and Liza]] * [[Juan]] * [[Wallace]] * [[Steven Stone]] * [[Archie]] * [[Maxie]] * [[Courtney]]/{{tt|Marge|Chuang Yi}} * [[Tabitha]]/{{tt|Mitch|Chuang Yi}} * [[Sird]] (silhouette) * [[Carr]] (silhouette) * [[Orm]] (silhouette) * [[Gabby and Ty]]/{{tt|Maryann and Tyler|Chuang Yi}} * [[Trick Master]]/{{tt|Robot King|Chuang Yi}} * [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] * [[Mr. Briney]] * [[Blind boy]] * [[Professor Cozmo]]/{{tt|Professor Starstone|Chuang Yi}} * [[Captain Stern]] * [[Dock]]/{{tt|Tuga|Chuang Yi}} * Ruby's [[mother]] * [[Wanda]]/{{tt|Wallene|Chuang Yi}} * {{adv|Riley}} * {{tc|Swimmer}} Jack * {{tc|Picnicker}} Kylee * [[Contest announcer]] * [[Pokémon Association]] Chairman * Old couple * [[Wallace]]'s cheerleaders * [[Professor Cozmo's assistants|Watasuke, Kūta, and Nonkichi]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Mightyena}} ([[Nana]]; [[blind boy]]'s) * {{p|Absol}} * {{p|Seviper}} (flashback) * {{p|Marill}} (doll) * {{p|Swablu}} (doll) * {{p|Mudkip}} (doll) * {{p|Torchic}} (doll) * {{p|Jigglypuff}} (doll) * {{p|Relicanth}} (on poster) * {{p|Loudred}} * {{p|Slakoth}} ==Trivia== * In the Japanese version, when Ruby and Sapphire are going away into the sunset at the end, the names of their game counterparts {{ga|Brendan}} and {{ga|May}} appear in the narration: "{{tt|今|いま}}、{{tt|勇気|ゆうき}}たずさえ…はるかなる{{tt|未来|みらい}}へ…‼" ("Keep your courage with you now... and you will go far in the future...!!") In this sentence, Brendan's Japanese name (ユウキ ''Yūki'') means "courage" and May's Japanese name (ハルカ ''Haruka'') means "far". ** Chuang Yi's translation is "So long as you possess courage... ...the world shall be your oyster!!"
